case.intent: Make your own fraction that is equal to a given fraction by choosing how to cut the circle

data.title: Pizza Party Equivalent Fractions

challenges.instruction: Make a fraction equal to 2/12 your own way: cut the circle into equal pieces, but not 12, then shade some.
challenges.hint: Think about cutting every piece into the same number of smaller pieces.
